notes: Adds an installer-gated 'Pulse Out 2' option on the Zones page: Alarm output 2 flashes about once a second instead of holding steady, as a visual alarm for a hearing-impaired occupant. Panel-wide, default off, so nothing changes unless it is enabled. Out 1 is always steady. Remote speakers flash in step and keep sounding their siren continuously, but only once their own firmware and the panel's comms module are updated too.
